title: Growing Your Career: J.B. Hunt's Driver Transfer Portal
summary: Need a different truck driving job? Learn how J.B. Hunt drivers internally transfer roles without starting over through our Driver Transfer Portal.
body_markdown:
**At a glance:** *The J.B. Hunt Driver Transfer Portal allows truck drivers to search and transfer to internal CDL driving jobs, giving them flexibility to change positions within J.B. Hunt as their life grows. Drivers can move between business units, locations and job types while maintaining their tenure, benefits and career progress within the company.*


Life changes. Your truck driving job should be able to change with you.


The truck driving job that's right for you today may not be the right fit years from now. Whether you're looking for different equipment, a new schedule, more[home time,](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/blog/why-drive-with-j-b-hunt/how-often-do-truck-drivers-get-home) a relocation or fresh opportunity, your career should be able to adapt as your life changes. J.B. Hunt's[Driver Transfer Portal](https://jbhuntcdp.powerappsportals.com/SignIn?ReturnUrl=%2f) ensures that you're never stuck in one place or one job.


## Find a Job That Fits Your Life


[Search Jobs](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/jobs)


## A Dedicated Driver's Mode to Intermodal


One of our drivers, Chad, had been driving a[Dedicated Contract Services®](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/jobs/dedicated-contract-services) route in New Jersey since 2012, when his family decided they needed to make a move to a slower environment.


"Last year, my family and I made the decision to transfer down from New Jersey and join the local intermodal crew in Haslet," Chad said. "We absolutely love it down here. I wish we had made the move sooner."


Chad didn't want to start over somewhere new, so he used the Driver Transfer Portal to search for open truck driving opportunities down south. He found plenty of positions and easily transferred from his New Jersey route to an[intermodal](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/jobs/intermodal) role in Texas. Chad was able to keep his tenure, benefits and previous driving history, along with receiving seamless relocation support.


## Trucking Technology That Supports Your Career


Chad's experience highlights a challenge many drivers face: choosing between a life change and the job stability they've earned.


The Driver Transfer Portal is a trucking technology resource designed to meet our drivers where they are. Drivers can search for open truck driving jobs nationwide and review positions in different business units, such as Dedicated, Intermodal or[Final Mile Services®](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/jobs/final-mile-services) .


Whether you're seeking the opportunity to get more home time, work with family changes, adapt to lifestyle adjustments or find a different CDL driver job, the portal provides a way to view options within J.B. Hunt while maintaining the tenure, benefits and relationships you've worked hard to build. This means you get to keep any milestone progress you've already made and work toward hitting those big accomplishments!


"Our transfer portal team made sure that we found the right position and fit for me, and once we made it down to Haslet, the local intermodal team helped me to hit the ground running."


Chad


## Truck Driving Jobs Built for the Long Haul


Truck driving jobs require hard work and dedication. That's why J.B. Hunt is committed to supporting our drivers for the long haul, not just at the start of their career. We're[Driven for You™](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/blog/why-drive-with-j-b-hunt/driven-for-you) , and we want to invest in your future, not just the position you fill.


Looking to make a change? Don't wait to grow your career! Call[1-877-791-9458](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/blog/truck-driving-jobs/%2B8777919458) or[pre-qualify](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/pre-qualify) to find the job that fits your lifestyle.


### Frequently Asked Questions


Want to know more about internal transfers and career advancement? Here are some answers to common questions drivers ask.


#### What is the J.B. Hunt Driver Transfer Portal?


The Driver Transfer Portal is a unique piece of technology that gives company drivers instant, easy access to J.B. Hunt's internal CDL driving jobs.


#### Can I transfer to a different type of driving job without leaving J.B. Hunt?


The Driver Transfer Portal is used to explore a variety of CDL driver jobs in different locations and business units within J.B. Hunt, including Dedicated Contract Services, Intermodal and Final Mile Services.


#### Do I keep my tenure if I transfer to another position?


Drivers can maintain their hard-earned tenure and[benefits](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/benefits/company-driver-benefits) when using the Driver Transfer Portal to move to a new position.


#### What other driver technology does J.B. Hunt have to help build long-term careers?


In addition to the Driver Transfer Portal, the[J.B. Hunt DRIVE App](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/blog/why-drive-with-j-b-hunt/drive-easy-with-the-j-b-hunt-drive-app) gives drivers a streamlined way to manage daily tasks, safety goals and personal performance.
